definitions.explanation: A percentage added to a bill at restaurants, hotels, and bars to cover service. Common in higher-end establishments and often shown as a fixed rate such as 10%.

examples.japanese: サービス{料|りょう}が{別|べつ}にかかります。
このホテルはサービス{料|りょう}が{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: At this hotel the service charge is included.

examples.japanese: {料金|りょうきん}にはサービス{料|りょう}と{消費税|しょうひぜい}が{加|くわ}わります。
examples.english: A service charge and consumption tax are added to the price.

notes:
Compound of サービス (service) + {料|りょう} (fee, charge). Japan has no tipping custom, so a service charge added to the bill plays a similar role at upscale venues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サービス{料|りょう}{込|こ}み: service charge included
- サービス{料|りょう}{別|べつ}: service charge not included
- サービス{料|りょう}がかかる: a service charge applies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {消費税|しょうひぜい}: consumption tax — a government tax, not a service fee
- {手数料|てすうりょう}: handling fee; commission — charged for processing, not service
